text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At last, my debut is behind us.
choice_data_list: One small step, as they say.
One small step, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As of today, we are true<n>contenders in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set for us to take the<n>Triple Crown.
Now, come—show me<n>your strategic acumen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Our path leads to the Classics, but<n>they are still
some way off. What<n>races should we attempt in my
junior<n>year?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf aims to demonstrate<n>her superiority
by deliberately taking<n>the thorniest road—the Classic
Triple<n>Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I don't want her to<n>push herself
too hard while she's still<n>in her junior year. The
Saudi Arabia<n>Royal Cup seems like a safe choice.
choice_data_list: How about the Saudi Arabia R.C.?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? How unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might opt for the Asahi<n>Hai Futurity
Stakes, or perhaps the<n>Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are they not where the best of the<n>juniors are
crowned?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's right, but we're already setting<n>our sights
high with the Classic Triple<n>Crown. The last thing
we need is to<n>make our agenda any harsher.
choice_data_list: We're not trying to be the best of the juniors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah... I see. I like the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then the Saudi Arabia R.C. it shall be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With that decided, we should<n>schedule our next—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: There she is! Symboli Rudolf! Over<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut! Do<n>you have a
message for your fans?
choice_data_list: Sorry, we're a little busy right now...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, we're being<n>swarmed by
reporters. Rudolf needs<n>to rest after her debut, so I
try to fend<n>them off, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No need to shield me, Trainer. Let me<n>deal with
them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course. As I said before the race,<n>the eyes of the
world are on us. We<n>mustn't waste that
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will be happy to take your questions.<n>One at a time,
if you please.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'll start! So, now that you've made<n>your racing
debut, what's next for<n>Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I hope to claim the Classic<n>Triple Crown.
To that end, I will<n>continue to compete as a junior...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It takes several hours for Symboli<n>Rudolf to answer
all of the reporters'<n>questions to her satisfaction.
By the<n>time we get back to the academy, it's
already evening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, I suppose this is where we<n>part ways.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Rest well, Trainer. You must be<n>exhausted after
today.
choice_data_list: I'll walk you to the dorm, at least.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to the dorm. I thought I<n>might attend to
some student council<n>business before turning in.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At this hour. The press interviews<n>concluded earlier
than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is to say, I fully expected to be<n>accosted by
reporters after the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You may not have heard that they<n>were coming, but
the members of the<n>press do not always observe
proper<n>protocol.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, many reporters would prefer<n>to hear
off-the-cuff reactions rather<n>than prepared
responses.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They will naturally come during the<n>moments after a
race, and all the<n>more so when the interviewee puts
forward a spotless image.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she was a lot more<n>prepared than I
was. I shouldn't have<n>let myself be caught
flat-footed like<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the public face of the student<n>body, I've had
more than my share<n>of dealings with the media.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You too shall get used to them in time,<n>like it or not.
After all, you are now the<n>Emperor's gate warden.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But we have strayed off topic. I have<n>work to
attend to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To be clear, Trainer, I am not exerting<n>myself simply
for the fun of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've made my debut, my<n>schedule will be
packed with training<n>and races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But I have no intention of shirking my<n>student
council duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Emperor must be the master ofboth the pen and the sword, or she isno Emperor at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All of which will only be possible if I<n>take care of my
health, of course.<n>Rest assured, I will not neglect
that<n>either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, unless I am mistaken, this<n>matter is settled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will see you tomorrow. Good night,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With that, she leaves, and I can't stop<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf is an incredible racer,<n>perceptive
about the world around<n>her, and attentive to her
own needs.<n>Most of the time, she probably<n>doesn't
need me at all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But I want to do everything I can to<n>make myself
useful on the few<n>occasions when she does.
Anything<n>to help her achieve her dream!
